chapter_title: Concerning the Five Forms that exist in the Rulers of Darkness.
chapter_note: This chapter is predominantly a systematic, correspondential cosmology: a five-form body-map for the Ruler of Darkness keyed to the five dark worlds, followed by two triads of additional faculties/qualities. The final two paragraphs pivot into direct exhortation (“my beloved ones… hold yourselves secure…”) consistent with editorial application/fatigue in the second half.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.77⟩
Consider the ruler, the leader of all the powers of darkness. Now, five forms exist in his body, corresponding to (the archetype) of the five creations that exist in the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic/dialogue frame: “Once again, the apostle is sitting among the congregation. He says to his disciples:” (Layer-2 attribution using “apostle”, seating scene, and address-introduction).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Frame attribution (“Once again… the apostle… says to his disciples”) is late editorial apparatus; the remaining sentence is impersonal cosmological system-building (five-fold structure; body ↔ five dark worlds) characteristic of the core substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: Indeed, his head is lion-faced, which came about from the world of fire. His wings and his shoulders are eagle-faced, after the likeness of the children of the wind. His hands and his feet are daemons, after the likeness of the children of the world of smoke. His belly is dragon-faced, after the likeness of the world of darkness. His tail is the form of the fish, which belongs to the world of the children of water. These five shapes are in him, and they came from the five creations of the five worlds of darkness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Pure cosmos→cosmos correspondential mapping (body regions and zoomorphic forms keyed to five dark worlds) with an impersonal expository voice; no audience address or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.78⟩
Should he wish, he shall walk on his two feet [ ... ] world of smoke. Also, when he wants, he shall [ ... ] four [ ... ] on his hands and feet [ ... ] like the children of fire. Should he wish, he shall rise up on his wings, like the children of the wind. Also, should he wish, he shall plunge down to the waters like the children of water. Again, should he wish, he shall crawl on his belly like the children of darkness. These five shapes are in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Operational description of the five-form complex (modes of movement corresponding to each dark-world ‘creation’). Still fully internal to cosmology; lacunae do not alter the systematic voice.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, there are three other (qualities) in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Structural transition marker introducing a numbered/triadic set—typical of the core’s schematic exposition.
Numbered list element (triadic faculty set). Although fragmentary, it belongs to the same schematic sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: Shall a [ ... ] his magic arts. When he wishes, he shall make an invocation over himself, and hide from his powers. When he wants, he shall show himself to them and strike a death-blow by his magic arts. Any word he might utter at that moment, he shall [wreak magic] by it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Describes an internal faculty of the Dark Ruler (magical concealment/manifestation and lethal speech) as ‘what he is able to do’ within the system, not as polemic about contemporary practitioners.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: His body is strong, a[1]] [ ... ] nails and claws of his powers are not able to penetrate it. No iron nor copper body will equal him [ ... ]; they will not be able to destroy him, because he was formed and fashioned from the hard-hearted counsel of Matter, the mother of demons and fiends.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-material constitution (hardness beyond metals) grounded in a mythic-cosmological generator (Matter as a personified cosmic source). No institutional or exhortative turn.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, there are three others in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second triadic set marker; schematic sequencing indicates the same teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: When he wants, his fire shall {blaze), and his entire body be made like the [ ... of] fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Elemental transformation as a faculty of the ruler; stays within cosmological/elemental register.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, when he wishes, he shall send out frost, and his entire body freezes like a [ ... of] snow.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of the same internal-faculty list (thermal/elemental powers), with no audience-facing application.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: Whenever his powers are stood before him, he shall look at them and understand; for [whatever ex]ists in their heart he shall understand, what is in their heart and their face so long as they are stood before him. When they retreat before him and distance themselves from him, he shall not understand what is in their heart. There is no life in him whatsoever, but his 'life' is the bile of anger that is apparent on his face and in his fear. Shall a [ ... ] destruction that is establ[ished be]fore him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Defines cognitive/affective mechanics of the Dark Ruler (limited ‘understanding’, anger as pseudo-life) in an impersonal explanatory mode; still a description of what he IS, not what the hearer must do.

Direct second-person exhortation (“my beloved ones… Hold yourselves secure…”) applying the cosmology to audience conduct; this is the application layer consistent with the chapter’s end-weighted editorial fatigue signal.
Continues hortatory voice and soteriological encouragement (“become zealous… inherit life for ever”); not a systematic cosmos→cosmos mapping, but behavioral/spiritual application.
